decision: Scans: NC Miata Full Car.stl (2026-10, 15.0M tris) + 2026-07 front states (Bumper only, Front Bumper Off hood closed/open, Hood and Bumper Removed) + 2023 'NC miata Trunk Closed/Open'
why: Brief's scan list; NC3 Body.stl and the epsilon Bumper Scan not needed (no states), fender-scoop and headlight-project files are product/CAD work, not this car

decision: One rigid levelling transform (tools/level.py: XY-PCA yaw -69.7 deg so nose=-Y, tilt 2.0 deg from the four tyre contact points) applied to every scan; car prepped once (car4.json) and every state scan prepped --like car4.json
why: Scan has no ground to fit a plane to; lesson: never re-normalise a part separately

decision: 2026 front-state scans used at identity in the car frame; 2023 trunk scans moved by FPFH+RANSAC+ICP (a90 globalreg.py, same pose 4/4 tries, fitness 0.41 @6 mm, rmse 4.4 mm); trunk-open is in trunk-closed's frame (p50 2.4 mm before ICP, ICP gains nothing)
why: Trimmed ICP of bo_hc vs car: p50 1.6 mm before, worse after (slides into the new under-bumper geometry). Coloured-over-silver renders (match/regcheck) z-fight on bumper, fenders, rear deck, plate and lamps = same surfaces

decision: Music = mazda-miata-nc_track.mp3 (generated for this reel by the parent session, ElevenLabs via Higgsfield); kick grid t = -0.524 + 0.58241 n (103.0 BPM, 4.3 ms rms, tools/accents.py); bars on odd beats; breakdown 16.37-18.70 s; drop on beat 33 = 18.696 s; last kick 36.75 s, music out 37.33 s, last audio 37.9 s
why: Brief: cut on this track's accents and measure where it ends. ive beats' strong onsets include 1/5-beat subdivisions, so the grid is fitted on the strongest 40-120 Hz kick peaks (lesson: anchor on the kick)

decision: Timeline: s1 front 3/4 turntable 0-4.718 (8 beats) | s2 rear 3/4 orbit -8.795 (7) | s3 wheel close-up -9.959 (2) | s4 headlight -11.124 (2) | s5 hood opens -14.036 (5) | s6 trunk opens -16.366 (4) | s7 top-down over the breakdown -18.696 (4) | s8 exploded view, panels separate ON the drop 18.696, lock 28.014 -30.344 (20) | s9 assembled hero -33.838 (6) | logo -38.0
why: Temerario order from the brief; every cut on a beat with varied holds (2-8 beats, lesson), cuts at 8.795/9.959/11.124 on the strongest backbeat flux accents; the quiet breakdown gets the floating top-down and the money shot lands on the drop; logo over the last 6 beats + tail so the video ends where the music does

decision: Hood: cut from the full car along its seam traced on a raw-scan normal map (tools/seammap.py + polycut.py, top skin only); opens 55 deg about the cowl seam over hb_off + bo_ho engine-bay geometry (tools/fill.py)
why: 'Front Bumper Off (Hood Open)' contains the bay but NOT the propped hood, so no hinge can be fitted; absent/present-in-state-scan masks gave ragged hood edges (state scans miss fender tops)

decision: Trunk lid: car tris inside the lid seam box and >12 mm from the 'Trunk Open' scan (tools/extract.py); hinge fitted to the captured open lid: 74.3 deg, median 1.0 mm, 92 % < 5 mm (tools/hinge.py); trunk interior from 'Trunk Open' (fill.py)
why: Open lid exists in the 2023 Trunk Open scan, so the motion is the real one

decision: Re-rendered s8_explode with studio lights hidden from camera rays
why: the orbit camera passed behind the 4 m key area light (rig scales with the bbox of parts stacked above the car); frames 20-145 rendered as a black silhouette on a dimly lit background
